summary.question: Do dead relays cluster on hosting providers (ASN) or on operators?
summary.method: DNS via dns.google DoH, ASN via RIPE Stat network-info/as-overview. Vantage-free. Caveats: Cloudflare fronting hides origin ASN (63+73 hosts count as CF); shared CF IPs excluded from same-IP clustering; DoH answers for CDNs can be geo-dependent.

findings.dns_dead: 107/312 dead relays (34%) have no A record at all — gone at DNS level, not an outage
findings.asn_concentration_same_for_dead_and_live: 50% of hosts sit on 4 ASNs in BOTH groups (CF, Hetzner, DO, Contabo)
findings.conclusion: Clustering is at the OPERATOR level (same IP / same domain), not primarily the provider level. Exception: hosts on Amazon/Railway (free-tier/trial patterns) die far above base rate.
